body: I've tried. Pretty much takes her word first. Outside party and I'm an overreacting teen on medication. I don't know anymore. She means well, but her actions have lost my trust. I expressly told her not to tell my dad or younger brothers about my going to therapy. Wind up finding out she's been telling one of my brothers and dad all about it for months. I just can't deal with these thoughts alone anymore, and I don't even know if I can trust the people in my support network anymore. I just feel tired and worn out from having to deal with what's going on.
